title: opencode-model-switcher configuration
description: User config for the model-switcher OpenCode plugin. Read once at plugin load; reload with touch plugins/model-switcher.ts.

providers.description: Provider preference order for groups without an explicit provider. Default: opencode, opencode-go, deepseek, zai-coding-plan.

long.description: Context window at or above which the long filter matches. Default 400000.

new.description: How many newest models the new sort keeps. Default 20.

list.description: How many lines a list prints and stores for use N. Default 30.

commands.description: Extra commands, or overrides of the built-ins, keyed by command name. The key becomes /<name>.

pairs.description: Free-paid fallback pairs. Each key becomes a command that switches to the primary and arms the fallback.

ref.description: A model reference: provider/model with an optional #variant.

filter.description: Narrows a group. Every key is optional; at least one is required.

think.description: Has a reasoning field or thinking/reasoning/effort variants.

long.description: Context window at or above the default threshold, or an explicit number.

new.description: Sorts by release date instead of price.

family.description: Family prefix, for example muse or deepseek.

side.description: A model reference, or a filter resolved to the cheapest match.

models.description: Pins a fixed list to cycle. model and models are alternatives to filter.

retry.description: Resend the last user prompt on the fallback when the failed turn produced no output. Default false.
